claimed_resolved.claim: every set of positive integers with divergent reciprocal sum contains arithmetic progressions of every finite length (the Erdős–Turán conjecture), with quasipolynomial Szemerédi bounds
W_r(k) > k^{ck⌊log₂ r⌋} for large k, so W(k)^{1/k} → ∞
R(Q_n) = Θ(2^n), the Burr–Erdős hypercube conjecture
P(n) < P(n+1) on a set of density 1/2 (the Erdős–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture)
an asymptotic equivalent for V(x), and V(cx)/V(x) → c for every fixed c > 0
the indices where p_n/n increases have positive lower density
the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes has bounded steps, so the answer is no
R(C_m,K_n) = (m−1)(n−1)+1 for m ≥ n ≥ 3, except R(C_3,K_3) = 6
the Ajtai–Erdős–Komlós–Szemerédi conjecture: a K_r-free graph of average degree d has an independent set of size Ω_r(n log d / d)
Hindman's finite sums and products conjecture
Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture: no finite modification of the primes is A+B with |A|,|B| ≥ 2, so the answer is no
N(b) ≪ log log b, which is the right order
±1 polynomials with modulus (1+o(1))√N on the whole unit circle for every large N, so the answer is no
infinitely many n have more than n^{1−ε} totient preimages, for every ε > 0
every graph's edges partition into O(n) cycles and edges, the Erdős–Gallai cycle-decomposition conjecture
a classification of the finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations by an algebraic condition over the coordinate field; it also disproves the Leader–Russell–Walters conjecture
f_d(n) ≥ c_d n^{2/d} for every fixed d ≥ 3, the grid order

claimed_partial.claim: the geometric case of the similarity conjecture: for every q ∈ (0,1), compact sets of measure close to 1 with no affine copy of {q^n}. The general case stays open. Step 3's #120 engine run was stopped on 2026-10-07 because its top target was this case
n points in the unit square with every triangle of area at least n^{−2+c}, a power improvement of the lower bound that disproves the conjectured almost-n^{−2} upper bound
every 5-colouring of the plane has a monochromatic unit pair, so χ(ℝ²) ∈ {6, 7}
squarefree values of irreducible quartics with the predicted density, and (d−2)-power-free density for degrees 4–8 under the local condition
